summary.content:
Today's selection covers 52 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 34 on Artificial Intelligence and 5 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Microsoft’s C.E.O. Intervened When OpenAI Fired Sam Altman, Musk’s Lawyer Claims
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 39 articles published in the last 24 hours
